notes.title: Companion Application + Vive Controls Update
notes.content:
Select the launch option "Launch Companion Application" in the launch options when starting the game in Steam to launch the stand alone Companion app. Export in-game drum kits to files, and launch MIDI with ease, tools and other options. Open the program manually, locate "Companion Application.exe" in the games installation root directory. 

VIve controls have changed a bit, you can now enter EDIT MODE via the left controller. Vive users please continue to send us your personal input.

tags.feature: Select the launch option "Launch Companion Application" in the launch options when starting the game in Steam to launch the stand alone Companion app.
Export in-game drum kits to files, and launch MIDI with ease, tools and other options.
Open the program manually, locate "Companion Application.exe" in the games installation root directory.
Vive controls have changed a bit, you can now enter EDIT MODE via the left controller.
Vive users please continue to send us your personal input.

notes.title: New Precision Drum Physics Framework Update
notes.content:
We have heard plenty of opinions from other drummers and other VR drumming game players. The update most have been waiting for is here in beta, physics update 2. Bringing drum emulation in VRDUS even more closer to realism with more precision. Let us know what you think, we will be improving methods and emulation of this new framework from here out.

+Graphical Note Highway update
+Overall performance on GPU improved

notes.title: Drums Sensitivity Update #1!
notes.content: Drum sensitivity update #1 is here! Bring a more realistic feel to our VR drum kit now with softer hits along with your harder ones. There will be another major update on this soon. Different layers of this framework will be updated from here going forward. This framework is still in testing, and will be being improved upon. Let us know what you think. 8/4/23
